invariants.rationale: The method only returns an Element from getChildrenByNameRecursively("property"), which should have name 'property', or null if no match.
A result is only returned if its 'name' attribute matches propName.
classElement is used directly without null checks, so must be non-null.
propName is used in equals without a null guard, so it is assumed non-null.
If result is non-null, it must come from the children of classElement found by getChildrenByNameRecursively.
